# opening_design

Drawings and CAD files from the public GitHub repositories of OpeningDesign, Madison, Wisconsin
(https://github.com/OpeningDesign). Files are unchanged and keep their original folders, because CAD files
reference each other by relative path.

Licence per file in the table below:
- CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/): credit OpeningDesign and the project
  team named in each title block. Adaptations you share must use CC BY-SA 4.0.
- MIT (repositories 104_Janesville and Schultz_Residence):

